title: Judge Approves $7 Billion Settlement Over Claims That Roundup Caused Cancer
summary: The ruling, in a nationwide class-action suit, is expected to end tens of thousands of lawsuits by people claiming that Roundup caused non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
